name: Josh McGrath
bio: A Crane School of Music graduate and piano teacher who instructed JD and Bronwyn in 2017. Became JD's mentor starting May 2021. Their weekly meetings at Park Bros Coffee — now spanning four years — are what JD describes as the best thing to ever happen to him. Direct communication style, non-transactional dynamic, the absence of the CFC restoration agenda made these meetings work where nearly a hundred others had not. His siblings: Matthew, Josiah (NY State Trooper), and Katie (go-between in the Bronwyn arc).
